external_scope: All eligible five-source base queries and gold evidence text reconstructed under adapter-policy-v3 before stage allocation.

tests.exact_string: case-sensitive full-string equality after surrounding whitespace trim
tests.normalized_string: casefold + Unicode apostrophe normalization + whitespace collapse full-string equality
tests.ngram: 12-token contiguous n-gram coverage; material when external text has >=2 12-grams and >=0.80 of its 12-grams appear in historical fingerprint corpus
tests.entity_namespace: regex for project-specific synthetic namespace/case markers including candidate-v<number>, gate labels, protected/confirmatory/final benchmark identifiers, entity_<number>, value_<number>, subject_<number>, relation_<number>
tests.query_skeleton: exact function-word/content-placeholder skeleton fingerprint; diagnostic only unless accompanied by material n-gram or namespace overlap
tests.memory_skeleton: same skeleton method for gold memory text; diagnostic only unless accompanied by material n-gram or namespace overlap

material_contamination: Any exact or normalized full-string overlap, any >=0.80 12-token n-gram coverage with >=2 n-grams, or any project-specific synthetic namespace marker in an external query/gold memory.
replacement_policy: Before any Candidate-v13 external output, material-contaminated base IDs are deterministically excluded and joint feasibility must be rerun under unchanged source/domain/family/stage targets. After first Candidate-v13 external output, newly discovered material contamination cannot be repaired by silent deletion; it triggers the preregistered INVALID/blocked handling.
persistence: Persist aggregate counts, source/domain counts, overlap-type counts and SHA256 digest of contaminated base IDs only. Do not persist external natural-language text or individual formal IDs.
